name: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Ltd
title: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Ltd - 544658 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Industry equity AUM fell 0.4% QoQ while ICICI Pru AMC equity AUM grew 2% QoQ to INR6.2tn, with Q4 PAT down 16.8% QoQ on mark-to-market losses and ESOP timing; no supply-side levers apply to an AMC.

triggers.label: Equity AUM share up 2% QoQ vs industry down
triggers.quote: This quarter stands in contrast to the industry, which has experienced a decline.

triggers.label: Net MF yield down ~1.4 bps on ETF mix
triggers.quote: So, a decline of 1.4 bps, I was just trying to reconcile that. So that would have been driven by the increase in the ETF mix, right

triggers.label: TER change adds 3-4 bps gross cost from 1 April
triggers.quote: if we look at on a gross basis before any pay out there is an impact of 3 to 4 basis point.

triggers.label: ICICI Ventures AIF mandates: INR46.28bn fee-paying AUM
triggers.quote: the fee paying committed funds which are moving to us as of 1st April 2026, that number is INR46.28 billion.

guidance.metric: TER / regulatory yield impact from 1 April
guidance.value: 3 to 4 bps gross impact, crystallised impact in two months
guidance.quote: if we look at on a gross basis before any pay out there is an impact of 3 to 4 basis point.

guidance.value: FY27 INR640-680mn; FY28 INR360-400mn; FY29 INR180-220mn
guidance.quote: The approximate debit to the P&L for FY27 would be INR640 to INR680 million

entities.name: ICICI Venture Funds Management Company Limited

red_flags.label: Q4 PAT down 16.8% QoQ; mark-to-market loss
red_flags.quote: We have recorded a negative other income of INR0.89 billion for the quarter ended March 2026 due to mark-to-market impact.

evasions.quote: It's pretty much in line with the industry. There's nothing specific that we can share.
Let's see how the numbers hold up.
